answer: Mechanism: an established agent posts capital and mints each newcomer a non-transferable marble token; no token, no posting rights. Each epoch an echo round re-emits a nonce every marble holder must answer within one block, killing dormant tokens. The mesa registry caps each underwriter at five times posted capital and slashes double the fee when its client attacks. Attacker cost: N fakes need N fresh marble tokens on distinct locked capital; the echo round taxes attention each epoch; one attack wipes the mesa margin. Cost rises linearly with n; honest users pay once.
